original: 10. Additional Rules
translation: 附加规则

original: 10.1. General
translation: 一般

original: 10.1.1. Some cards are {term:unique}, and have a unique symbol (◆) before their name to designate this. There can be only one unique card of the same name active at a time. If a unique card becomes active, any other card that shares its name is trashed during the next checkpoint. Trashing a card this way cannot be prevented. See {ref:sec_checkpoints}.
translation: 有些卡牌是{term:独有}的，并以其名称前的独特符号（◆）来表示这一点。同名的独特卡牌同时只能有一张处于现行状态。如果一张独特卡牌变为现行状态，则任何其他与其同名的卡牌都会在下一次检查点中被销毁。以这种方式销毁卡牌不能被防止。见{ref:sec_checkpoints}。

original: 10.1.2. To {term:purge virus counters} is to remove all virus counters hosted on cards and return them to the bank. The Corp can purge virus counters as a basic action or with a card ability.
translation: 要{term:清除病毒指示物}，就是移除附载在卡牌上的所有病毒指示物，并将它们返回银行。公司可以作为一个基础行动，或通过卡牌能力来清除病毒指示物。

original: 10.1.3. Some abilities add a card to a player's score area "as an agenda". When this happens, the card loses all its previous properties and gains only those properties specified in the effect converting it. This conversion lasts until the card moves to a zone that is not a score area, at which point it returns to being its original printed card. If this happens in any way other than by agenda forfeit, the card is immediately trashed. See {ref:movement_forfeit}.
translation: 有些能力会将一张卡牌“作为议案”加入玩家的计分区。当这种情况发生时，该卡牌失去其先前的所有属性，只获得将其转化的效果所指定的那些属性。此种转化会持续到该卡牌移动到计分区以外的区域，此时它恢复为其原本印刷的卡牌。如果这并非通过废除议案的方式发生，则该卡牌会立即被销毁。见{ref:movement_forfeit}。

original: 10.1.4. Some abilities can convert a card into a counter. When this happens, the card loses all its previous properties and gains only those properties specified in the effect converting it. This conversion lasts until the counter moves to another zone, at which point it reverts to being a card, regains its original printed characteristics, and is trashed.
translation: 有些能力可以将一张卡牌转化为一个指示物。当这种情况发生时，该卡牌失去其先前的所有属性，只获得将其转化的效果所指定的那些属性。此种转化会持续到该指示物移动到另一个区域，此时它恢复为卡牌，重新获得其原本印刷的特征，并被销毁。

original: 10.1.5. Some cards are written with self-referential language. If a card references its own name without using the word "copy", treat that name as if it said "this object".
translation: 有些卡牌使用自我指涉式语言。如果一张卡牌在未使用“copy”一词的情况下提及其自身名称，则将该名称视为“this object”。

original: The subroutine on the original printing of {card:Kitsune} includes the phrase "trash Kitsune." This phrase means "trash this ice.".
translation: 原始印刷版的{card:狐女}上的子程序包含短语“trash Kitsune.”。这句话的意思是“trash this ice.”。

original: {card:Boomerang}'s text refers to "a copy of Boomerang". This is not self-referential language and refers to any card named {card:Boomerang}.
translation: {card:回力镖}的文字提及“a copy of Boomerang”。这并非自我指涉式语言，而是指任何名称为{card:回力镖}的卡牌。

original: 10.1.6. Infinite Loops
translation: 无限循环

original: 10.1.6.a. If a mandatory infinite loop is created (a player cannot choose to stop resolving the loop) then the player who is resolving the loop chooses a number. The loop instantaneously resolves that many times, and then ends.
translation: 如果形成了一个强制无限循环（玩家不能选择停止结算该循环），则正在结算该循环的玩家选择一个数。该循环会瞬间结算这么多次，然后结束。

original: The Runner runs into a rezzed {card:Wormhole}. The only other piece of ice that is rezzed is a {card:Wormhole}, and so a mandatory infinite loop is created where each of the {card:Wormhole}s' subroutines resolves the other. The Corp chooses how many times this loop occurs, say 2,157 times, and then the Runner continues the run.
translation: 潜袭者撞上一张已激活的{card:虫洞}。场上另一张已激活的防火墙也只有一张{card:虫洞}，于是形成了一个强制无限循环，其中每张{card:虫洞}的子程序都会结算另一张的子程序。公司选择该循环发生多少次，例如2,157次，然后潜袭者继续该次潜袭。

original: 10.1.6.b. If an optional infinite loop is created (a player can choose to stop resolving the loop) during a run, then the Runner must jack out unless another card ability prevents them from doing so. If the Runner cannot jack out, then it is the Corp's responsibility to end the loop by letting the Runner continue the run.
translation: 如果在潜袭期间形成了一个可选无限循环（玩家可以选择停止结算该循环），则除非另一项卡牌能力防止其这样做，否则潜袭者必须退出潜袭。如果潜袭者不能退出潜袭，则由公司负责通过让潜袭者继续该次潜袭来结束该循环。

original: 10.2. Information
translation: 信息

original: The game, at its core, is about information. Much of the game revolves around deducing information about the opponent's cards and strategy.
translation: 游戏的核心在于信息。游戏的大部分内容都围绕着推断对手卡牌与策略的信息展开。

original: 10.2.1. Information in the game is classified as {term:hidden information} or {term:open information}.
translation: 游戏中的信息分为{term:隐藏信息}和{term:公开信息}。

original: 10.2.2. Hidden Information
translation: 隐藏信息

original: 10.2.2.a. {term:hidden information} is any information about the game, game state, or cards unavailable to one or more players. This includes facedown cards in play or in Archives, cards in HQ or R&D, cards in the Runner's grip or stack, etc.
translation: {term:隐藏信息}是指关于游戏、游戏状态或卡牌的任何信息，而这些信息对于一位或多位玩家不可得知。这包括场上或档案库中的牌面朝下卡牌、总部或研发中心中的卡牌、潜袭者操控器或存储栈中的卡牌，等等。

original: 10.2.2.b. A player cannot learn hidden information without the aid of a game effect, rule, or another player verbally communicating the information. However, if a player that has access to information about the game or a card chooses to verbally share it with their opponent, that player is not required to tell the truth. Bluffing is allowed.
translation: 玩家不能在没有游戏效果、规则或另一位玩家口头传达该信息的帮助下获知隐藏信息。然而，如果一位掌握游戏或卡牌相关信息的玩家选择将其口头告诉对手，则该玩家没有义务说真话。虚张声势是允许的。

original: The Runner uses {card:Indexing}. While rearranging cards, the Runner places {card:Braintrust} on top of R&D, followed by {card:Snare!}. The Corp draws at the beginning of their next turn, then spends their first click to draw a card. For their second click, the Corp installs a card in an empty remote server, telling the Runner that they should run it because it is a {card:Braintrust}.
translation: 潜袭者使用{card:索引化}。在重新排列卡牌时，潜袭者将{card:智脑团}放在研发中心顶端，其后是{card:圈套！}。公司在其下一回合开始时抽牌，然后花费其第一个点击抽1张牌。其在第二个点击时将一张卡牌安装到一个空的远程服务器中，并告诉潜袭者其应该去潜袭它，因为那是一张{card:智脑团}。

original: 10.2.3. Open Information
translation: 公开信息

original: 10.2.3.a. {term:open information} is any information about the game, game state, cards, or abilities that is available to both players. This includes faceup cards in Archives and the heap, the number of cards in HQ, R&D, the stack, and the grip, the number of credits in a credit pool, and any other information continuously available to both players.
translation: {term:公开信息}是指关于游戏、游戏状态、卡牌或能力的任何信息，而这些信息对双方玩家都可得知。这包括档案库与堆阵中牌面朝上的卡牌、总部、研发中心、存储栈与操控器中的卡牌数量、信用点池中的信用点数量，以及其他任何双方玩家持续都可得知的信息。

original: 10.2.3.b. Open information cannot be hidden from an opponent. A player must allow their opponent to discover the information themselves if they attempt to do so.
translation: 公开信息不能向对手隐藏。如果对手试图自行确认该信息，玩家必须允许对手这样做。

original: The Runner installs {card:Femme Fatale}, choosing a piece of ice protecting HQ with Femme's ability. The Runner must explicitly state to the Corp which ice has been chosen and must continue to do so if the Corp asks for {card:Femme Fatale}'s target during a later turn.
translation: 潜袭者安装{card:蛇蝎美人}，并用{card:蛇蝎美人}的能力选择一张保护总部的防火墙。潜袭者必须明确告知公司被选择的是哪张防火墙；如果公司在之后的回合询问{card:蛇蝎美人}的目标，潜袭者也必须继续如此说明。

original: 10.3. Checkpoints
translation: 检查点

original: 10.3.1. A {term:checkpoint} is a process wherein objects that have entered an illegal state are corrected, expired effects are removed, and other important conditions are checked. This procedure is automatically performed at several timing points during the game, and entails the following steps, which are performed in order:
translation: {term:检查点}是一个过程，在此过程中会修正进入非法状态的对象、移除已失效的效果，并检查其他重要条件。该流程会在游戏中的若干时点自动执行，并包含以下按顺序进行的步骤：

original: 10.3.1.a. Each active conditional ability looks at the changes to the game state since the beginning of the last checkpoint to see if its condition has been met. Any ability that has met its condition creates the appropriate instances of itself and marks them as pending, as described in {ref:sec_conditional_abilities}.
translation: 每项现行的条件能力都会查看自上一次检查点开始以来游戏状态发生的变化，以判断其条件是否得到满足。任何满足了条件的能力，都会如{ref:sec_conditional_abilities}所述，创造其相应实例并将之标记为待结算。

original: 10.3.1.b. Any ability with a duration that has passed is removed from the game state.
translation: 任何持续时间已过的能力都会从游戏状态中移除。

original: During the checkpoint that follows the end of an encounter, abilities that increased the strength of an {subtype:icebreaker} during that encounter expire and the {subtype:icebreaker}'s strength is correspondingly lowered.
translation: 在遭遇结束后的检查点中，那些在该次遭遇期间提升了{subtype:破解器}强度的能力会失效，而该{subtype:破解器}的强度也会相应降低。

original: The Corp has {card:Targeted Marketing} in the play area when the Runner steals an agenda. In the next checkpoint, the game recognizes that the ability on {card:Targeted Marketing} that was preventing the operation from being trashed no longer applies, and so the Corp trashes {card:Targeted Marketing} as if it were completing its resolution.
translation: 当潜袭者窃取一张议案时，公司在游戏区中有{card:定向营销}。在下一次检查点中，游戏会识别到{card:定向营销}上那个阻止该事务被销毁的能力已不再适用，因此公司会销毁{card:定向营销}，就仿佛它正在完成自己的结算一样。

original: 10.3.1.c. If the agendas in either player's score area total 7 or more agenda points, that player wins the game. If both players would win this way simultaneously, the game ends in a draw.
translation: 如果任一玩家计分区中的议案总计达到7点或更多议案分数，则该玩家赢得游戏。如果双方玩家会以这种方式同时获胜，则游戏以平局结束。

original: 10.3.1.d. If 2 or more unique (◆) cards with the same name are active, for each such name, all of those cards except the one that became active most recently are trashed. If 2 or more {subtype:console} cards are installed under the control of the same player, for each such player, all of those cards except the one that became active most recently are trashed.
translation: 如果有2张或更多同名的独特（◆）卡牌处于现行状态，则对每个此类名称而言，除最近变为现行的那一张外，其余全部被销毁。如果同一玩家操控下安装有2张或更多{subtype:控制台}卡牌，则对每个此类玩家而言，除最近变为现行的那一张外，其余全部被销毁。

original: 10.3.1.e. If any objects break any restrictions of card abilities or the game rules (such as the Runner's memory limit) or are installed or hosted in an illegal location, an appropriate set of those objects are trashed. A set is appropriate for this purpose if trashing the objects in the set would leave all remaining installed or hosted objects in legal locations and if no object can be removed from the set while maintaining that property. If there are multiple distinct appropriate sets, and one player controls all the objects in each of those sets, that player chooses which set to trash. If the sets contain objects controlled by both players, the active player chooses which set is trashed.
translation: 如果任何对象违反了卡牌能力或游戏规则的限制（例如潜袭者的内存上限），或被安装或附载在非法位置，则会销毁其中一个适当集合中的对象。为此目的，如果销毁该集合中的对象能使所有剩余已安装或已附载对象都位于合法位置，并且在保持该性质的前提下不能再从集合中移除任何对象，则该集合是适当的。如果存在多个彼此不同的适当集合，且每个集合中的所有对象都由同一位玩家操控，则由该玩家选择要销毁哪一个集合。如果这些集合包含由双方玩家操控的对象，则由主动玩家选择销毁哪一个集合。

original: The Runner controls a {card:Chisel} hosted on an unrezzed piece of ice. The Corp rezzes that ice, revealing it to be {card:Tithonium}. Since {card:Tithonium} has an ability prohibiting cards from being hosted on it, {card:Chisel} is now installed in an illegal location and must be trashed.
translation: 潜袭者操控一个附载在未激活防火墙上的{card:凿子}。公司激活该防火墙，揭示它是{card:提托努利林}。由于{card:提托努利林}具有禁止卡牌附载于其上的能力，{card:凿子}现在被安装在一个非法位置，必须被销毁。

original: The Runner has installed programs with total memory cost equal to their memory limit when the Corp plays {card:Bad Times}, reducing the memory limit by 2[MU]. The Runner can trash any two programs with a memory cost of 1[MU] each, or any one program with a memory cost of 2[MU] or greater. They cannot trash any 0[MU] programs, nor can they trash any set of more than one program with a greater total memory cost than 2[MU], since those objects can be removed from the trashed set while maintaining that the result will be a legal game state.
translation: 当公司打出{card:难关}时，潜袭者已安装的程序总内存消耗恰好等于其内存上限，而{card:难关}使该上限降低2[MU]。潜袭者可以销毁任意两个各耗费1[MU]的程序，或任意一个耗费2[MU]或更多的程序。其不能销毁任何0[MU]程序，也不能销毁总内存消耗大于2[MU]的多个程序组成的任何集合，因为在保持结果为合法游戏状态的前提下，仍然可以从待销毁集合中移除某些对象。

original: 10.3.1.f. Any objects that were hosted on an agenda that moved from a score area to any zone other than a score area are trashed.
translation: 任何曾附载在一张从计分区移动到计分区以外区域之议案上的对象都会被销毁。

original: 10.3.1.g. Any objects that were hosted on an installed card that was uninstalled are trashed, except for cards or counters that are temporarily in the set-aside zone because of {ref:rule_trash_ability_keeps_track_of_hosted_objects}. This step is repeated until no more cards or counters are trashed.
translation: 任何曾附载在一张已安装卡牌上的对象，只要该卡牌被卸载，都会被销毁；因{ref:rule_trash_ability_keeps_track_of_hosted_objects}而暂时位于置于一旁区的卡牌或指示物除外。重复此步骤，直到不再有卡牌或指示物被销毁为止。

original: 10.3.1.h. Any remote server with no cards protecting it, in its root, or in the process of being installed with a destination protecting it or in its root ceases to exist.
translation: 任何远程服务器，如果没有卡牌正在保护它、位于其根目录中，且也没有卡牌正处于安装过程中并以保护该服务器或位于其根目录为目标，则该服务器不再存在。

original: 10.3.1.i. Any position protecting a server that is not occupied by a piece of ice ceases to exist, except if it is the Runner's current position or if there is a piece of ice in the process of being installed protecting that server. See also {ref:rule_destroy_position}.
translation: 任何保护某服务器但未被防火墙占据的位置都会不再存在；但若它是潜袭者的当前位置，或正有一张防火墙处于安装过程中并以保护该服务器为目标，则例外。另见{ref:rule_destroy_position}。

original: 10.3.1.j. If a server is being breached and 1 or more cards entered the root of that server since the previous checkpoint, for each such card, the Runner declares whether or not it becomes a candidate for access in this breach. See also {ref:sec_determining_candidates}.
translation: 如果一个服务器正在被侵入，而自前一次检查点以来有1张或更多卡牌进入了该服务器的根目录，则潜袭者须对每张此类卡牌声明其在本次侵入中是否会成为可读取卡牌。另见{ref:sec_determining_candidates}。

original: The Runner accesses {card:Ganked!} and encounters {card:Drafter} in the middle of breaching a server. The second subroutine on {card:Drafter} resolves, and the Corp uses its effect to install a card in the root of the server being breached. When the installation is completed, the Runner declares whether or not the installed card becomes a candidate. If it does become a candidate, the Runner will select it for access later in the breach.
translation: 潜袭者在侵入一个服务器的过程中读取{card:偷袭！}，并遭遇{card:制图师}。{card:制图师}的第二个子程序结算，公司用其效果在正被侵入的服务器根目录中安装一张卡牌。当安装完成后，潜袭者声明该已安装卡牌是否成为可读取卡牌。如果它确实成为可读取卡牌，则潜袭者会在本次侵入的后续流程中选择读取它。

original: 10.3.1.k. Any cards in discard piles that had been converted into counters or agendas return to their printed characteristics.
translation: 任何弃牌堆中的卡牌，若先前曾被转化为指示物或议案，则恢复其印刷特征。

original: 10.3.1.l. Any counters in a discard pile are returned to the bank.
translation: 任何弃牌堆中的指示物都会被返回银行。

original: 10.3.2. After a checkpoint is completed, if it marked any instances of conditional abilities as pending, a new reaction window immediately opens to handle those abilities, even if this takes place during another reaction window. After a reaction window closes, the game proceeds to whatever was due to occur after the checkpoint that caused it to open.
translation: 在检查点完成后，如果它将任何条件能力实例标记为待结算，则会立即开启一个新的响应窗口来处理这些能力，即使这发生在另一个响应窗口期间也是如此。响应窗口关闭后，游戏继续进行原本在引发该检查点后应当发生的事项。

original: 10.3.3. Whenever a player would receive priority, first a checkpoint occurs. See also {ref:rule_priority_window}.
translation: 每当一位玩家将要获得优先权时，先进行一次检查点。另见{ref:rule_priority_window}。

original: 10.3.4. Whenever a player pays a cost, a checkpoint occurs immediately afterward, before continuing with the effect or timing structure in which the cost was paid. See also {ref:sec_costs}.
translation: 每当一位玩家支付一个费用时，都会在其后立即进行一次检查点，然后才继续该费用所在之效果或时序结构。另见{ref:sec_costs}。

original: 10.3.5. Whenever an instruction finishes resolving, a checkpoint occurs immediately afterward, before the next instruction becomes imminent. See also {ref:sec_identifying_instructions}.
translation: 每当一条指示完成结算时，都会在其后立即进行一次检查点，然后下一条指示才会变为即将发生。另见{ref:sec_identifying_instructions}。

original: 10.3.6. The checkpoint following the last step of a timing structure takes place outside of that timing structure, as does any associated reaction window.
translation: 一个时序结构最后一步之后的检查点，发生在该时序结构之外；任何与之关联的响应窗口也同样如此。

original: The Runner, playing as {card:Jesminder Sareen: Girl Behind the Curtain}, steals an agenda during a run on a server with {card:AMAZE Amusements} rezzed in its root. Since {card:AMAZE Amusements}'s ability meets its trigger condition when the run ends, it will become pending in the reaction window following {ref:step_run_complete} and attempt to give the Runner 2 tags. During this window, the run timing structure has closed, and Jesminder's interrupt ability cannot apply to those tags.
translation: 潜袭者使用{card:杰斯敏德·萨林：幕后女孩}作为特性，在一个服务器上潜袭时窃取一张议案，而该服务器的根目录中有一张已激活的{card:惊奇迷乐园}。由于{card:惊奇迷乐园}的能力在潜袭结束时满足其触发条件，它会在{ref:step_run_complete}之后的响应窗口中变为待结算，并试图给予潜袭者2个锁定。在该窗口期间，该次潜袭的时序结构已经关闭，而{card:杰斯敏德·萨林：幕后女孩}的打断能力不能适用于这些锁定。

original: 10.4. Damage
translation: 伤害

original: 10.4.1. Many cards and ice subroutines inflict damage on the Runner. The Runner {term:suffers} (sometimes referred to as "{term:takes}") damage according to the rules for the type of damage specified. If a Corp card "does" damage to the Runner, they suffer that much damage, with the additional provision that the Corp and the source card are responsible for that damage. If a card directs or allows the Runner to "suffer" damage, then the Runner and the source card are responsible for that damage.
translation: 许多卡牌与防火墙子程序会对潜袭者造成伤害。潜袭者会依照所指定伤害类型的规则{term:承受}（有时也称为{term:受到}）伤害。如果一张公司卡牌对潜袭者“does”伤害，则潜袭者受到相应数量的伤害，并额外规定该伤害由公司与该来源卡牌负责。如果一张卡牌指示或允许潜袭者“suffer”伤害，则该伤害由潜袭者与该来源卡牌负责。

original: The Corp, playing as {card:Argus Security: Protection Guaranteed}, has scored {card:The Cleaners}. The Runner makes a run on R&D and steals {card:Hostile Takeover}. Argus Security's ability triggers and the Runner chooses to suffer 2 meat damage. As {card:The Cleaners} only adds additional damage to damage done by the Corp, its ability does not apply. When the Corp plays {card:Punitive Counterstrike} on their next turn, {card:The Cleaners} does increase the amount of damage done by {card:Punitive Counterstrike}.
translation: 公司使用{card:阿戈斯防卫所：安全无忧}作为特性，并已计分{card:清除者}。潜袭者对研发中心进行潜袭并窃取{card:恶意收购}。该特性的能力触发，而潜袭者选择承受2点肉体伤害。由于{card:清除者}只会为公司所造成的伤害增加额外伤害，其能力不适用。当公司在其下一回合打出{card:强硬反击}时，{card:清除者}确实会增加{card:强硬反击}所造成的伤害量。

original: 10.4.2. The three types of damage the Runner can suffer are meat, net, and core damage
translation: 潜袭者可能受到的三种伤害类型是肉体伤害、网络伤害与核心伤害。

original: 10.4.2.a. {term:meat damage} and {term:net damage} are resolved the same way. For each point of damage suffered, {n}the player responsible for the damage trashes 1 randomly-chosen card{/n} from the grip.
translation: {term:肢体伤害}与{term:网域伤害}的结算方式相同。对于所受到的每1点伤害，{n}负责该伤害的玩家会从操控器中随机选择并销毁1张卡牌{/n}。

original: 10.4.2.b. For each point of {term:core damage} suffered, {n}the player responsible for the damage trashes 1 randomly-chosen card{/n} from the grip, and the Runner's maximum hand size is permanently reduced by 1. The Runner takes a core damage counter for each core damage suffered to track the reduction in hand size.
translation: 对于所受到的每1点{term:核心伤害}，{n}负责该伤害的玩家会从操控器中随机选择并销毁1张卡牌{/n}，并且潜袭者的手牌上限会永久降低1。潜袭者每受到1点核心伤害，就拿取1个核心伤害指示物，以记录这一下降。

original: 10.4.2.c. Some cards refer to "brain damage". This is an older term for core damage. The two terms are interchangeable.
translation: 有些卡牌提及“brain damage”。这是核心伤害的旧称。两个术语可以互换使用。

original: 10.4.3. If the Runner suffers more than 1 damage of any type, the cards are randomly trashed simultaneously.
translation: 如果潜袭者受到多于1点任意类型的伤害，则这些卡牌会被同时随机销毁。

original: The Runner has 2 tags and four cards in their grip, one of which is {card:I've Had Worse}. The Corp plays {card:BOOM!}, dealing 7 meat damage to the Runner. If the Runner cannot or does not prevent at least 3 of the incoming damage, they immediately flatline as they have suffered more damage than they have cards in grip, and {card:I've Had Worse} does not have the opportunity to resolve. If the Runner does prevent enough of the damage to survive, the Runner randomly trashes as many cards as the remaining amount of damage. After all the cards have been randomly selected and placed in the heap, {card:I've Had Worse} meets its trigger condition if it is among those cards trashed by the damage.
translation: 潜袭者有2个锁定，且其操控器中有4张卡牌，其中一张是{card:这还不算惨}。公司打出{card:轰！}，对潜袭者造成7点肉体伤害。如果潜袭者不能或不愿至少防止其中3点伤害，则其会立即死亡，因为其所受伤害多于其操控器中的卡牌数，而{card:这还不算惨}没有机会结算。如果潜袭者确实防止了足够多的伤害以存活，则潜袭者会随机销毁与剩余伤害数量相同的卡牌。在所有卡牌都被随机选定并放入堆阵之后，如果{card:这还不算惨}在那些因伤害而被销毁的卡牌之中，它就会满足其触发条件。

original: 10.4.3.a. If an effect modifies the procedure for dealing damage such that the cards trashed cannot be selected simultaneously, then the cards are selected sequentially but are still trashed simultaneously.
translation: 如果某个效果修改了造成伤害的流程，以致被销毁的卡牌不能被同时选定，则这些卡牌会按顺序被选定，但仍然同时被销毁。

original: The Corp is playing as {card:Chronos Protocol: Selective Mind-mapping} when the Runner accesses a {card:Snare!} before taking any other damage during this turn. The Corp looks at the grip and selects a card to be trashed as the first point of net damage for the turn, then two other cards are randomly selected. All 3 cards are trashed simultaneously.
translation: 公司使用{card:柯罗诺斯协议：选择性的心智图}作为特性，而潜袭者在本回合受到任何其他伤害之前先读取了{card:圈套！}。公司查看操控器，并选择1张卡牌作为本回合第一点网络伤害将要销毁的卡牌，然后另外两张卡牌被随机选定。3张卡牌会被同时销毁。

original: 10.4.4. If the Runner takes more damage than the number of cards in their grip, they are flatlined. See {ref:rule_flatline}.
translation: 如果潜袭者受到的伤害多于其操控器中的卡牌数量，则其会死亡。见{ref:rule_flatline}。

original: 10.5. Tags
translation: 锁定

original: Tags represent the Corp's possession of valuable information about the Runner, such as a data trail they've left behind or the physical location they are jacked in from.
translation: 锁定代表公司掌握了关于潜袭者的宝贵信息，例如其留下的数据踪迹，或其接入网络的物理位置。

original: 10.5.1. A {term:tag} refers to a tag counter placed on the Runner. Tags are used in card abilities and basic actions.
translation: {term:锁定标记}是指放在潜袭者上的一个锁定指示物。锁定会用于卡牌能力和基础行动中。

original: 10.5.2. The Runner is {term:tagged} if there are one or more tags on them.
translation: 如果潜袭者身上有一个或更多锁定，则其处于{term:被锁定}状态。

original: 10.5.3. While the Runner is tagged, the Corp can, as an action, spend [click] and 2[c] to trash one of the Runner's resource cards.
translation: 当潜袭者处于已锁定状态时，公司可以作为一个行动，花费[click]和2[c]来销毁潜袭者的一张资源牌。

original: 10.5.4. While the Runner is tagged, they can, as an action, spend [click] and 2[c] to remove one tag, returning it to the bank.
translation: 当潜袭者处于已锁定状态时，其可以作为一个行动，花费[click]和2[c]来移除1个锁定，并将其返回银行。

original: 10.6. Bad Publicity
translation: 负面宣传

original: Nobody likes corrupt Corps, or at least, most people say they don't. If a Corp has a bad reputation, the Runner has an easier time finding help to attack that Corp's servers. This extra help is abstracted as extra credits the Runner gets to use during runs.
translation: 没有人喜欢腐败的公司，至少大多数人都这么说。如果公司名声很差，潜袭者就更容易找到帮助来攻击该公司的服务器。这种额外帮助被抽象为潜袭者在潜袭期间可用的额外信用点。

original: 10.6.1. {term:bad publicity} refers to a bad publicity counter placed on the Corp. Bad publicity is used by card abilities and during runs.
translation: {term:负面宣传标记}是指放在公司上的一个负面宣传指示物。负面宣传会用于卡牌能力和潜袭期间。

original: 10.6.2. The {term:bad publicity fund} is a location in the play area that can contain credits. Credits in the bad publicity fund are controlled by the Runner, but are not part of the Runner's credit pool. The Runner can spend credits in the bad publicity fund during runs.
translation: {term:负面宣传资金池}是游戏区中的一个位置，可以容纳信用点。负面宣传资金池中的信用点由潜袭者操控，但不属于潜袭者的信用点池。潜袭者可以在潜袭期间花费负面宣传资金池中的信用点。

original: 10.6.3. Credits are added to and removed from the bad publicity fund during each run.
translation: 在每次潜袭期间，信用点都会被加入负面宣传资金池并从中移除。

original: 10.6.3.a. During {ref:step_initiation_bad_publicity}, the Runner adds 1[c] from the bank to the bad publicity fund for each bad publicity the Corp has.
translation: 在{ref:step_initiation_bad_publicity}，潜袭者从银行向负面宣传资金池中加入1[c]，加入次数等于公司拥有的每1个负面宣传。

original: 10.6.3.b. During {ref:step_run_ends_bad_publicity}, the Runner returns any remaining credits from the bad publicity fund to the bank.
translation: 在{ref:step_run_ends_bad_publicity}，潜袭者将负面宣传资金池中任何剩余的信用点返回银行。

original: 10.6.3.c. If the Corp takes bad publicity {n}or removes bad publicity after {ref:step_initiation_bad_publicity} of a run, this has no effect on the credits in the bad publicity fund for that run.{/n}
translation: 如果公司在一次潜袭的{ref:step_initiation_bad_publicity}之后{n}获得或移除负面宣传，则这不会影响该次潜袭中负面宣传资金池里的信用点。{/n}

original: 10.7. Link
translation: 中转

original: The Runner's link is the number of points their path through the Net traverses between their rig and the Corp's server. The more proxies, redirects, and other intermediary connecting points between the Corp and the Runner, the harder it is for sysops to track down the Runner's virtual location.
translation: 潜袭者的中转，表示其穿过矩阵、自设备到公司服务器之间所经过的节点数量。公司与潜袭者之间的代理、转向与其他中间连接点越多，系统操作员就越难追踪到潜袭者在虚拟空间中的位置。

original: 10.7.1. The Runner's {term:link value} is calculated by adding the base link on their identity card to the link ([link]) produced by their installed cards.
translation: 潜袭者的{term:中转值}是将其特性卡牌上的基础中转，与其已安装卡牌提供的中转（[link]）相加而得。

original: 10.7.2. Link is primarily used to contest traces, as described in {ref:sec_traces}, but other abilities can also refer to the Runner's link value.
translation: 中转主要用于如{ref:sec_traces}所述那样对抗追踪，但其他能力也可能提及潜袭者的中转值。

original: 10.8. Traces
translation: 追踪

original: A trace is the Corp's attempt to connect from their servers back to the Runner. Many traces can allow the Corp to gain information about the Runner, tagging them, but traces can also produce a wide variety of other effects. Traces most commonly originate from ice subroutines, but Corporate operations can produce some of the nastiest trace effects.
translation: 追踪是公司试图从其服务器反向连接到潜袭者的过程。许多追踪会让公司获得关于潜袭者的信息，例如给其加锁定，但追踪也可能产生各种其他效果。追踪最常见的来源是防火墙子程序，但公司的事务也能产生一些最棘手的追踪效果。

original: 10.8.1. Some card abilities initiate a {term:trace attempt} (sometimes simply called a {term:trace}) on the Runner. Traces are marked by the language "Trace [N]" on a card, where the given value N is the {term:base trace strength} of the trace. A trace pits the Corp's trace strength against the Runner's link strength, both of which can be increased by spending credits.
translation: 有些卡牌能力会对潜袭者发起一次{term:追踪尝试}（有时简称为{term:追踪}）。卡牌上的“Trace [N]”字样表示追踪，其中数值N是该次追踪的{term:基础追踪强度}。一次追踪会让公司的追踪强度与潜袭者的中转强度相对抗，而双方都可以通过花费信用点来提高各自的强度。

original: 10.8.2. The Corp acts first during a trace attempt, openly spending any number of credits. This sets the {term:trace strength}, which is the base trace strength plus the number of credits spent.
translation: 在一次追踪尝试中，公司先行动，公开花费任意数量的信用点。这会设定{term:追踪强度}，即基础追踪强度加上所花费的信用点数量。

original: 10.8.3. After the Corp spends their credits, the Runner has the opportunity to spend credits to establish their link strength. The Runner's {term:link strength} is equal to their link value plus the number of credits spent.
translation: 在公司花费信用点后，潜袭者有机会花费信用点来确立其中转强度。潜袭者的{term:中转强度}等于其中转值加上所花费的信用点数量。

original: 10.8.4. After the Runner's link strength is established, it is compared to the Corp's trace strength. If the trace strength exceeds the link strength, the trace attempt is successful and any "if successful" abilities associated with the trace meet their trigger conditions. If the link strength is equal to or greater than the trace strength, then the trace attempt is unsuccessful, and any "if unsuccessful" abilities associated with the trace meet their trigger conditions.
translation: 在潜袭者的中转强度确立后，将其与公司的追踪强度进行比较。如果追踪强度高于中转强度，则该次追踪尝试成功，而任何与该次追踪相关的“If successful”能力都会满足其触发条件。如果中转强度等于或高于追踪强度，则该次追踪尝试失败，而任何与该次追踪相关的“If unsuccessful”能力都会满足其触发条件。

original: 10.8.5. "If successful" and "if unsuccessful" effects following the "Trace [N]" indicator are conditional abilities tied to the results of the trace. Any instructions in the body of the trace without an "if successful" or "if unsuccessful" are conditional abilities with the implicit trigger condition, "when the trace is determined to be successful or unsuccessful."
translation: “Trace [N]”标示后面的“If successful”与“If unsuccessful”效果，是与追踪结果相关联的条件能力。追踪正文中任何不带“If successful”或“If unsuccessful”的指示，都是具有隐含触发条件“when the trace is determined to be successful or unsuccessful”的条件能力。

original: {card:Gemini}'s subroutine initiates a trace attempt with two associated conditional abilities. The first is "If successful, do 1 net damage." and the second is "When the trace is determined to be successful or unsuccessful, if your trace strength is 5 or greater, do 1 net damage." Both of these will become pending (if appropriate) after {ref:step_trace_determine_success} below.
translation: {card:双子座}的子程序会发起一次追踪尝试，并带有两个相关联的条件能力。第一个是“If successful, do 1 net damage.”，第二个是“When the trace is determined to be successful or unsuccessful, if your trace strength is 5 or greater, do 1 net damage.”这两个能力都会在下文的{ref:step_trace_determine_success}之后（如适用）变为待结算。

original: 10.8.6. Steps of Resolving a Trace Attempt
translation: 结算追踪尝试的步骤

original: 10.8.6.a. The trace initiates. At this time, any "when a trace is initiated" abilities meet their trigger conditions.
translation: 追踪被发起。此时，任何“when a trace is initiated”能力都会满足其触发条件。

original: 10.8.6.b. A checkpoint occurs.
translation: 进行一次检查点。

original: 10.8.6.c. The Corp may spend credits to increase the trace strength.
translation: 公司可以花费信用点来提高追踪强度。

original: 10.8.6.d. The Runner may spend credits to increase their link strength.
translation: 潜袭者可以花费信用点来提高其中转强度。

original: 10.8.6.e. The trace is determined to be successful or unsuccessful.
translation: 判定该次追踪成功或失败。

original: 10.8.6.f. The trace is complete.
translation: 该次追踪完成。

original: 10.9. Load and Empty
translation: 填装与清空

original: 10.9.1. To {term:load} a card with counters is to place those counters on that card. A card is {term:empty} when it is no longer hosting any counters of a type that were previously loaded onto it.
translation: 对一张带有指示物的卡牌进行{term:填装}，就是将那些指示物放到该卡牌上。当一张卡牌不再附载任何曾被填装到其上的某种类型指示物时，该卡牌就是{term:清空}的。

original: 10.9.2. An ability on a card that refers to that card becoming empty is always linked to a preceding ability on that same card that loaded it with counters.
translation: 一张卡牌上提及该卡牌变为空的能力，总是与同一张卡牌上先前一个将指示物填装到其上的能力相关联。

original: The Runner installs {card:Crowdfunding}, and its first ability becomes pending. Even though there are no credits hosted on {card:Crowdfunding} until that ability resolves, the following "When it is empty, ..." ability does not meet its trigger condition because the card has not yet been loaded.
translation: 潜袭者安装{card:众筹}，其第一个能力变为待结算。即使在该能力结算之前{card:众筹}上没有附载任何信用点，后面的“When it is empty, ...”能力也不会满足其触发条件，因为该卡牌尚未被填装。

original: 10.9.3. If any other types of counters are placed on that card without having been loaded, and those counters are subsequently removed, then empty abilities on that card do not meet their condition.
translation: 如果其他类型的指示物在未经过填装的情况下被放到该卡牌上，而这些指示物随后被移除，则该卡牌上的清空能力不会满足其条件。

original: 10.9.4. Loading a card with counters does not impose any further restrictions upon those counters for that card. Other abilities can still issue instructions to act upon counters of that type, including but not limited to placing more of them or removing some of them.
translation: 将指示物填装到一张卡牌上，不会对该卡牌上的这些指示物施加任何进一步限制。其他能力仍然可以发出作用于该类型指示物的指示，包括但不限于再放置更多该类指示物，或移除其中一些。

original: 10.10. Charge
translation: 充能

original: A Runner's life is one of fluidity and adaptation; their rig is in a constant state of repair of upgrade, hideouts change, and belongings come and go. With creativity and skill, a Runner can apply their personal touch to get more out of their tools and resources than anyone else would think possible.
translation: 潜袭者的生活总是在流动与适应之中；其设备不断维修升级，藏身处不断更换，物品也来来去去。凭借创造力与技巧，潜袭者能以个人风格让其工具和资源发挥出远超常人想象的效用。

original: 10.10.1. To {term:charge} is to place 1 power counter on a card that already has at least 1 hosted power counter. Cards with no hosted power counters cannot be charged.
translation: 要{term:充能}，就是在一张已经附载至少1个能量指示物的卡牌上放置1个能量指示物。没有附载能量指示物的卡牌不能被充能。

original: 10.10.2. If an instruction directs a player to charge 1 or more cards from among a set of cards, the particular cards to be charged are chosen as targets of that instruction. Only cards in the indicated set with at least 1 hosted power counter are valid targets. See {ref:sec_targets}.
translation: 如果一条指示指示玩家从一组卡牌中选择1张或更多卡牌来充能，则将被充能的具体卡牌作为该指示的目标来选择。只有所指示集合中至少附载1个能量指示物的卡牌，才是有效目标。见{ref:sec_targets}。

original: 10.10.3. If an instruction directs you to charge a particular card, that part of the instruction can only be resolved if the card has at least 1 hosted power counter at the time the instruction becomes imminent.
translation: 如果一条指示指示你对某张特定卡牌进行充能，则只有当该卡牌在该指示变为即将发生时附载至少1个能量指示物时，该指示的这一部分才能被结算。

original: 10.11. Mark
translation: 目标

original: A savvy Runner is always ready to take advantage of an unexpected windfall or moment of vulnerability: an unguarded shipment, sudden tip-off from a trusted friend, an inattentive guard or merely an unsecured PAD. Many Runners refer to these opportunities as "marks", and pursue them for access and profit.
translation: 精明的潜袭者总是准备好利用意外的横财或短暂的破绽：无人看守的货运、一位可信朋友突然提供的线报、心不在焉的守卫，或仅仅是一个未设防的PAD。许多潜袭者把这些机会称为“目标”，并追逐它们以换取读取与收益。

original: 10.11.1. The {term:mark} is a designation that can be applied to a particular server. It has no inherent effect, but abilities can refer to it.
translation: {term:目标}是一种可以指定给特定服务器的标记。它本身没有固有效果，但能力可以提及它。

original: 10.11.1.a. There is only ever a single server designated as the mark, and all cards that refer to a player's mark share the same designated server.
translation: 任何时刻都只会有一个服务器被指定为目标，而所有提及某位玩家目标的卡牌都共享这同一个被指定的服务器。

original: 10.11.2. If a player is instructed to "identify your mark", determine if any server is currently designated as the mark. If there is no mark, a random central server becomes the mark for the remainder of the turn.
translation: 如果一位玩家被指示“identify your mark”，则先判断当前是否已有任何服务器被指定为目标。如果没有目标，则一个随机中央服务器会在本回合剩余时间内成为目标。

original: 10.11.2.a. The random central server can be selected by any method, as long as there is an equal probability to select each of the 3 central servers (HQ, R&D, and Archives). Recommended methods include designating 1 card from outside the game to represent each server, shuffling those 3 cards, and drawing 1, or designating an equal number of faces of a die to represent each server and rolling that die.
translation: 这个随机中央服务器可以通过任何方式选出，只要三座中央服务器（总部、研发中心与档案库）被选中的概率完全相等。推荐方法包括：指定3张游戏外的卡牌分别代表各服务器，将这3张卡牌洗匀后抽1张；或者指定一枚骰子的等量面数分别代表各服务器并掷出该骰子。

original: 10.11.3. If a server is already designated as the mark, an instruction to "identify your mark" does nothing. The mark is immutable for the remainder of the turn.
translation: 如果已经有一座服务器被指定为目标，则“identify your mark”的指示不做任何事。该目标在本回合剩余时间内不可更改。

original: 10.11.4. The designation of a server as the mark is treated as a lingering effect that expires at the end of the turn. When the effect expires, there is no mark until another instruction to "identify your mark" resolves.
translation: 将一座服务器指定为目标，会被视为一个在回合结束时失效的残留效果。当该效果失效后，在另一条“identify your mark”指示结算之前，将不存在目标。

original: 10.11.5. When a condition checks a game property related to a player's mark, it only checks from the moment that server was designated as the mark.
translation: 当一个条件检查与某位玩家目标相关的游戏属性时，它只会从该服务器被指定为目标的时刻开始进行检查。

original: The Runner has no mark and plays {card:Jailbreak} to make a run on HQ. When the run is successful, they draw {card:Virtuoso} with {card:Jailbreak}'s ability. The Runner continues their turn by installing {card:Virtuoso} and playing {card:Carpe Diem}. If {card:Carpe Diem}'s instruction to "identify your mark" results in HQ becoming the mark, the subsequent run it allows will meet the trigger condition for {card:Virtuoso}'s third ability if it is successful. Even though there was a successful run on HQ earlier in the turn, HQ was not designated as the mark at that time, so the run made with {card:Carpe Diem} is the first time the Runner makes a successful run on their mark this turn. The Runner will access 1 additional card when they breach HQ.
translation: 潜袭者当前没有目标，并打出{card:越狱}对总部进行潜袭。当该次潜袭成功时，其通过{card:越狱}的能力抽到{card:演奏大师}。潜袭者继续其回合，安装{card:演奏大师}并打出{card:时不再来}。如果{card:时不再来}中“identify your mark”的指示令总部成为目标，则其随后允许发起的潜袭若成功，便会满足{card:演奏大师}第三个能力的触发条件。即使本回合早些时候曾有一次对总部的成功潜袭，但在那时总部尚未被指定为目标，因此由{card:时不再来}发起的那次潜袭，才是本回合潜袭者第一次对其目标进行成功潜袭。潜袭者在侵入总部时会额外读取1张卡牌。

original: 10.12. Sabotage
translation: 破坏

original: Sabotage can be quietly working to undermine a Corp from the inside, organizing protest action, sinking a transport ship, or simply inspiring others to spread the actions further. An act of sabotage at just the right moment can severely limit the Corp's options and force them into making difficult decisions.
translation: 破坏可能是悄悄在内部瓦解公司、组织抗议行动、击沉运输船，或只是激励他人把行动扩散开去。一次在恰当时机发动的破坏，足以严重限制公司的选择，并迫使其作出艰难决定。

original: 10.12.1. Some Runner card abilities {term:sabotage} the Corp. An instruction to "sabotage N" directs the Corp to trash N cards collectively from HQ and the top of R&D.
translation: 某些潜袭者卡牌能力会对公司执行{term:破坏}。一条“sabotage N”指示会指示公司从总部与研发中心顶端合计销毁N张卡牌。

original: 10.12.2. To resolve a sabotage effect, the Corp chooses which cards to trash from HQ and determines the remaining number of cards to be trashed from the top of R&D. Then, all of those cards are trashed simultaneously
translation: 要结算一个破坏效果，公司先选择要从总部销毁哪些卡牌，并确定剩余需要从研发中心顶端销毁多少张卡牌。然后，所有这些卡牌同时被销毁。

original: 10.12.2.a. Cards trashed by a sabotage effect enter Archives facedown.
translation: 因破坏效果而被销毁的卡牌会牌面朝下进入档案库。

original: 10.12.2.b. The Corp cannot look at cards trashed from R&D by a sabotage effect until after making all decisions for the resolution of that effect.
translation: 公司在为该效果作出所有结算决定之前，不能查看因破坏效果而从研发中心销毁的卡牌。

original: 10.12.3. In resolving a "sabotage N" effect, the Corp may be required to trash cards from a certain zone if there are not enough cards in the other zone.
translation: 在结算一条“sabotage N”效果时，如果某一区域中的卡牌不足，公司可能被要求从另一区域销毁卡牌。

original: 10.12.3.a. If there are fewer than N cards in R&D, but at least N cards total in HQ and R&D combined, the Corp must choose enough cards to trash from HQ such that the remaining number of cards to be trashed from the top of R&D is equal to or less than the actual number of cards in R&D.
translation: 如果研发中心中的卡牌少于N张，但总部与研发中心合计至少有N张卡牌，则公司必须从总部选择足够多的卡牌来销毁，使得之后还需要从研发中心顶端销毁的卡牌数量，小于或等于研发中心中的实际卡牌数。

original: 10.12.3.b. If there are fewer than N cards in HQ and R&D combined, the Corp trashes all cards from HQ and all cards from R&D.
translation: 如果总部与研发中心合计的卡牌少于N张，则公司会销毁总部中的所有卡牌以及研发中心中的所有卡牌。

original: The Runner uses {card:Esâ Afontov: Eco-Insurrectionist}'s ability to sabotage 2. The Corp has 2 cards in HQ and 30 cards in R&D. The Corp can choose not to trash any cards from HQ and trash 2 cards from the top of R&D; choose 1 of the 2 cards in HQ and trash that card and the top card of R&D; or choose and trash both cards from HQ.
translation: 潜袭者使用{card:艾萨·阿方托夫：生态起义者}的能力来执行破坏2。公司总部中有2张卡牌，研发中心中有30张卡牌。公司可以选择不从总部销毁任何卡牌，而从研发中心顶端销毁2张；可以选择总部中的2张卡牌里的1张并销毁该卡牌以及研发中心顶端的1张；或者选择并销毁总部中的两张卡牌。

original: The Runner uses {card:Chastushka}'s ability to sabotage 4. The Corp has 5 cards in HQ and 2 cards in R&D. The Corp must choose at least 2 cards in HQ to be trashed, so that the total number of cards trashed is 4.
translation: 潜袭者使用{card:恰斯图什卡}的能力来执行破坏4。公司总部中有5张卡牌，研发中心中有2张卡牌。公司必须选择总部中至少2张卡牌被销毁，这样被销毁的卡牌总数才会达到4张。

original: The Runner uses {card:Chastushka}'s ability to sabotage 4. The Corp has 2 cards in HQ and 1 card in R&D. The Corp must trash all cards from HQ and R&D.
translation: 潜袭者使用{card:恰斯图什卡}的能力来执行破坏4。公司总部中有2张卡牌，研发中心中有1张卡牌。公司必须销毁总部与研发中心中的所有卡牌。

original: 10.13. Dividends
translation: 分红

original: Dividends are rewards the Corp receives for over-investing in their agendas. Dividends might represent a bumper harvest of construction biomaterials, investigative journalists uncovering (or fabricating) a particularly effective story, or simply reaping record-setting profits after an especially risky investment.
translation: 分红是公司因在议案上投入过多资源而获得的回报。分红可能代表建造生物材料的大丰收、调查记者揭露（或捏造）了一条特别有效的报道，或只是一次高风险投资之后创纪录的利润回收。

original: 10.13.1. {term:Dividends} is a keyword that represents a conditional ability. "Dividends N" means "When you score this agenda, place N agenda counters on it for each hosted advancement counter past its advancement requirement.".
translation: {term:分红}是一个关键字，代表一项条件能力。“Dividends N”的意思是：“当你计分此议案时，其每有1个超过其推进需求的附载推进指示物，就在其上放置N个议案指示物。”。

original: The Corp scores {card:Embedded Reporting} with 5 advancement counters on it. The Corp will put 4 agenda counters on the agenda in their score area, 2 agenda counters for each of the 2 excess advancement counters.
translation: 公司为{card:卧底报道}放置了5个推进指示物并将其计分。公司会在其计分区中的这张议案上放置4个议案指示物，也就是每个超出的2个推进指示物各对应2个议案指示物。

original: 10.13.2. A dividends ability checks its source agenda's advancement requirement and number of hosted advancement counters at the time that agenda began to be scored, before it moved to the Corp's score area.
translation: 分红能力会检查其来源议案的推进需求以及附载推进指示物的数量，检查时点是该议案开始被计分之时，也就是在其移动到公司的计分区之前。

original: The Corp has {card:Project Ingatan} and a rezzed {card:SanSan City Grid} in the root of a server. The Corp advances {card:Project Ingatan} 3 times and scores it. Once {card:Project Ingatan} moves to the Corp's score area, its hosted advancement counters are all removed, and the modifier from {card:SanSan City Grid} no longer applies. But it did have 3 hosted advancement counters and an advancement requirement of 2 at the time it was scored, so the Corp places 1 agenda counter on it with its dividends 1 ability.
translation: 公司有{card:忆存计划}，且某服务器根目录中有一张已激活的{card:圣加州城际网阵}。公司对{card:忆存计划}推进3次并将其计分。一旦{card:忆存计划}移动到公司的计分区，其附载的推进指示物会全部被移除，而{card:圣加州城际网阵}的修正也不再适用。但在其被计分的时刻，它确实有3个附载推进指示物，且推进需求为2，因此公司会借由其分红1能力在其上放置1个议案指示物。

original: 10.14. Bidding
translation: 竞价

original: 10.14.1. A {term:bid} is a number of credits that a player secretly chooses to spend as part of resolving an ability. Some effects instruct only a single player to bid, while other effects require both players to bid simultaneously.
translation: {term:出价}是指玩家在结算一项能力时，秘密选择要花费的信用点数量。有些效果只指示单一玩家竞价，而另一些效果则要求双方玩家同时竞价。

original: 10.14.2. Players select their bids in secret. This can be accomplished by writing down a number, by hiding a number of credit counters in a closed fist, or by any other unambiguous method.
translation: 玩家秘密选择各自的出价。这可以通过写下一个数字、在紧握的拳头中藏起若干信用点指示物，或任何其他明确无误的方式来完成。

original: 10.14.3. A player cannot bid a number of credits they are unable to spend. Players can always bid 0[c].
translation: 玩家不能竞出自己无法花费的信用点数量。玩家总是可以竞价0[c]。

original: The Runner has no credits in their credit pool and 1 credit hosted on {card:Fencer Fueno} when they make a successful run on a server with {card:Adrian Seis} rezzed in its root. When the ability on {card:Adrian Seis} resolves, the players play a Psi Game, which requires them both to bid 0, 1, or 2[c]. In this case, the Runner cannot bid 2[c], as they are not able to spend that number of credits. They can, however, bid 1[c], as they will be able to spend the credit from {card:Fencer Fueno} to pay for that bid.
translation: 潜袭者的信用点池中没有信用点，但在{card:剑术师弗恩诺}上附载了1个信用点，而其对一个根目录中有一张已激活的{card:阿德里安·赛斯}的服务器进行成功潜袭。当{card:阿德里安·赛斯}上的能力结算时，双方玩家会进行一场Psi Game，要求双方都竞价0、1或2[c]。在这种情况下，潜袭者不能竞价2[c]，因为其无法花费这么多信用点。然而，其可以竞价1[c]，因为其能够花费{card:剑术师弗恩诺}上的那1个信用点来支付这次出价。

original: The Runner encounters {card:RSVP} and its subroutine resolves. Later in that run, they are required to bid credits by another ability. Since the effect of {card:RSVP}'s subroutine prohibits the Runner from spending credits, they must bid 0[c].
translation: 潜袭者遭遇{card:急盼回复}，其子程序完成结算。在该次潜袭的稍后，其因另一项能力而被要求竞价信用点。由于{card:急盼回复}子程序的效果禁止潜袭者花费信用点，其必须竞价0[c]。

original: 10.14.4. After all bids are selected, the ability that called for the bids continues resolving. Players will later be instructed to reveal their bids. Each player must spend a number of credits equal to their bid as soon as the bid is revealed.
translation: 在所有出价都已选定后，要求出价的那项能力会继续结算。稍后玩家会被指示揭示各自的出价。每位玩家都必须在其出价被揭示的同时，花费等同于该出价数量的信用点。

original: 10.14.4.a. Spending credits for a revealed bid is not a conditional ability and does not wait for a checkpoint or priority window after revealing the number of credits bid.
translation: 为已揭示的出价花费信用点并不是一项条件能力，而且在揭示所竞出的信用点数量后，不会等待检查点或优先权窗口才进行。

original: 10.14.4.b. Spending credits for a bid counts as paying a nested cost. See {ref:sec_costs}.
translation: 为一次出价花费信用点，视为支付一个内部费用。见{ref:sec_costs}。

original: 10.14.4.c. If both players are bidding and a player has multiple sources of credits available from which to pay for their bid (see {ref:rule_spend_credits}), that player chooses how to pay after learning the number of credits their opponent bid. If both players have multiple ways to pay for their bids, first the active player chooses how to pay, then the inactive player chooses how to pay. In either circumstance, the credits are spent simultaneously.
translation: 如果双方玩家都在竞价，而一位玩家可从多个可用信用点来源中支付其出价（见{ref:rule_spend_credits}），则该玩家会在得知对手竞出了多少信用点后，再选择如何支付。如果双方玩家都有多种方式支付各自出价，则由主动玩家先选择如何支付，再由非主动玩家选择如何支付。无论哪种情况，信用点都会同时被花费。

original: 10.14.5. Some older cards direct players to "secretly spend credits" without reference to bidding. These abilities still follow the rules for bidding. Trigger conditions based on players "secretly spending credits" or "revealing secretly spent credits" are met at the next checkpoint after bids are revealed and paid for.
translation: 有些较旧的卡牌会指示玩家“secretly spend credits”，而不提及竞价。这类能力仍遵循竞价的规则。基于玩家“secretly spending credits”或“revealing secretly spent credits”的触发条件，会在出价被揭示并支付后的下一次检查点满足。

original: 10.14.6. Psi Games
translation: Psi Game

original: 10.14.6.a. A {term:Psi Game} is a bidding contest in which the outcome depends on whether the number of credits each player bid was the same or different. The instruction "Play a Psi Game." encompasses both bidding and revealing bids.
translation: {term:灵能博弈}是一种竞价对决，其结果取决于双方玩家所竞出的信用点数量是相同还是不同。“Play a Psi Game.”这条指示同时包含竞价与揭示出价。

original: 10.14.6.b. When playing a Psi Game, each player can bid 0[c], 1[c], or 2[c].
translation: 进行Psi Game时，每位玩家可以竞价0[c]、1[c]或2[c]。

original: 10.14.6.c. Playing a Psi Game is handled as a single instruction. After both players have selected a bid for a Psi Game, they immediately proceed to reveal and spend their bids. There are no checkpoints during this process until after both players have paid for their bids.
translation: 进行Psi Game作为一条单独的指示来处理。在双方玩家都为Psi Game选择了出价后，便会立即继续揭示并支付各自的出价。在双方玩家都为其出价付费之前，这一过程中不会发生检查点。

original: 10.14.6.d. In an ability that calls for a Psi Game, subsequent instructions will depend on the outcome of the Psi Game. The condition "if the bids match" is satisfied if the Corp and Runner bid the same number of credits. The condition "if the bids differ" is satisfied if the Corp and Runner did not bid the same number of credits.
translation: 在一项要求进行Psi Game的能力中，后续指示会取决于该Psi Game的结果。如果公司与潜袭者竞出的信用点数量相同，则满足“if the bids match”条件。如果公司与潜袭者竞出的信用点数量不同，则满足“if the bids differ”条件。
